title: 第十五章 内息境第十六章 镇武局
content_zh:
齐达也不理他，他接到楚元的消息之后就火速赶来，现在还不了解具体的情况；
便扭头看向楚元，训斥道“太冲动了！你知不知道这样有多危险！？”
楚元不以为意“如果对方是想要我的命，就直接对我下手了，还费那么大功夫去杀李琛”
见状，齐达火气更大“胡闹！你觉得自己很聪明么！？”
“”
楚元不说话，齐达也有些无奈；
他知道楚元说的有道理，可这种行为本来就很冒险。
他只是让楚元留意一下身边的异常，比如有没有什么人刻意接近他，但从来没说过让他主动寻找异常啊
治安局那位队长似乎是要弥补刚才队员说错话的行为，主动开口道“齐校长，您这位学生的实力确实很强！”
“再强也是一个学生！”齐达冷哼一声“说说吧，具体什么情况？”
“具体就是那个假冒我的人出现了，杀了周哲的父亲；
然后这位队长怀疑我自导自演，特地找来了内息境的武者陪我演这场戏”
齐达点了点头“楚元一个学生，他的人际关系你们调查不到么？
这么说的话，嫌疑最大的好像是我？”
“”
楚元想了想，好像和自己关系比较近的高阶武者，也的确只有齐达？
确实是他的嫌疑最大，但治安局的那个队长可不敢接这个话茬，只得讪笑两声。
齐达走到破碎的窗户面前，向下看去；
夜幕虽黑，可对于五境的武者来说也不算什么。
很快，他的目光就落在了一处，神色微微一凝；

那里，沥青路面显现蛛网一般的裂纹，似乎被巨力撞击过。
有几率鲜血洒落在周围
“那里就是那个冒牌货最终逃走的地方？”
“是。”
“谁出的手？”齐达有些疑惑的看向队长，在场只有他是内息境的武者，应该就是他出的手；
但是又有点不像，这队长如果能把人打伤的话，应该早就追上去了才对
并且他这个内息境是有点水分的；
治安局就是这样，实力并不强；
因为他们主要面对的对象还是普通人，关于武者的案子，尤其是高阶武者，另有机构负责。
也就是除了军方之外，每座城里最大的暴力机构镇武局。
只不过楚元和李琛之间毕竟还不算正式武者，再加上齐达的担保
所以一开始轮不到他们出动，镇武局的人手也总是不足的，他们有其他更重要的任务。
但今夜之后，已经确定有另外的武者在背后搞鬼，或许也该轮到他们接手了
齐达心中的念头一闪而逝，又听到楚元回答；
“我做的。”
“你？”齐达疑惑的目光看来；
“确实是这位楚元同学出手，他在凶手逃跑的时候，把长剑当成暗器丢了出去！”队长补充道，随后把桌子上断掉的残剑拿起来递给齐达；
“就是这把剑！”
齐达目光凝重，剑倒是没什么好说的，只是普通的工艺品；
但他忽然发现自己忽略了一个问题！

便猛然抬头看向楚元“你现在是什么境界！？”
“算了，回去再说！”
眼见到齐达旁若无人的带着楚元离开，队长一旁的女治安员有些无法接受；
“队长！就这么让他们走了？”
content_en:
Qi Da ignored him. He rushed over after receiving the news from Chu Yuan. He still doesn’t know the specific situation;
Then he turned to look at Chu Yuan and scolded, "You're too impulsive! Do you know how dangerous this is!?"
Chu Yuan didn't take it seriously, "If the other party wanted my life, they would have attacked me directly and spent so much effort to kill Li Chen."
Seeing this, Qida became even more angry, "What nonsense! Do you think you are smart!?"
""
Chu Yuan didn't speak, and Qi Da was also a little helpless;
He knew what Chu Yuan said made sense, but this kind of behavior was inherently risky.
He just asked Chu Yuan to pay attention to the abnormalities around him, such as if anyone approached him deliberately, but he never asked him to actively look for abnormalities.
The captain of the Public Security Bureau seemed to want to make up for the wrong words spoken by the team members just now, and took the initiative to say, "Principal Qi, your student is indeed very strong!"
"No matter how strong you are, you are still a student!" Qi Da snorted coldly. "Tell me, what is the specific situation?"
“The specific thing is that the person pretending to be me appeared and killed Zhou Zhe’s father;
Then the captain suspected that I was directing and acting on my own, so he specially hired a warrior from the Inner Breath Realm to accompany me in this scene."
Qi Da nodded, "Chu Yuan is a student, can't you investigate his interpersonal relationships?
If you say that, it seems that I am the most suspect? "
""
Chu Yuan thought for a while, and it seemed that the only high-level warrior who was close to him was Qi Da?
It was true that he was the biggest suspect, but the captain of the Public Security Bureau did not dare to answer this question, so he could only laugh twice.
Zida walked to the broken window and looked down;
Although the night is dark, it is nothing to the warriors of the fifth realm.
Soon, his eyes fell on one place, and his expression froze slightly;
There, the asphalt road surface showed spiderweb-like cracks, as if it had been hit by a huge force.
There is a chance that blood will be scattered around
"Is that where the imposter finally escaped?"
"Yes."
"Who made the move?" Qi Da looked at the captain with some confusion. He was the only warrior present in the Inner Breath Realm, so he should have made the move;
But it's a bit different. If the captain could injure someone, he would have caught up with him long ago.
Moreover, his inner breath state is somewhat watery;
The Sheriff's Department is just like that, not very strong;
Because they mainly deal with ordinary people, there is another agency responsible for the cases of warriors, especially high-level warriors.
That is, apart from the military, the Suppression and Martial Arts Bureau is the largest violent organization in every city.
It’s just that Chu Yuan and Li Chen are not yet formal warriors after all, and with Qi Da’s guarantee,
Therefore, it was not their turn to dispatch at first, and the manpower of the Suppression and Martial Arts Bureau was always insufficient. They had other more important tasks.
But after tonight, it has been confirmed that there are other warriors behind the scenes, and it may be their turn to take over.
The thought in Qi Da's mind flashed away, and he heard Chu Yuan's answer again;
"I did it."
"You?" Qida looked at him with doubtful eyes;
"It was indeed this classmate Chu Yuan who took action. When the murderer was escaping, he threw the long sword as a hidden weapon!" the captain added, then picked up the broken sword on the table and handed it to Qi Da;
"That's the sword!"
Qi Da’s eyes were serious, there was nothing much to say about the sword, it was just an ordinary handicraft;
But he suddenly realized that he had overlooked a problem!
He suddenly raised his head and looked at Chu Yuan, "What state are you in now!?"
"Forget it, let's talk about it when we get back!"
Seeing Qi Da leaving with Chu Yuan as if there was no one around, the female security officer next to the captain couldn't accept it;
"Captain! Just let them go like this?"
